chapter: Parade bands, instruments and the Eureka band
title: Playing in the Eureka band
summary: Gabriel says he was a member of the Eureka band with T-Boy, playing saxophone, drums or clarinet as needed.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Oh yeah, you still have your E flat. Did you ever play many parades in the old days? Well I played. I'm a member of the Ricker band.
I got T-Boy with me. I was a member of the Ricker band. Oh yes.
Yeah I used to play this. I remember when T-Boy was the manager. T-Boy.

Well I'm in that X-Squad with him. You see X-Squad book you'll see Manny Gabriel. I'm playing saxophone not clarinet. Because we used Piku. When Piku didn't play then I played or John Cash. I played the saxophone. If they were short of the drummer I played the drums. Yeah. The Albert system too.
